name: Warm analog cinematic pad with pitch drift and opposing pan
goal: Build a warm Juno-style cinematic pad: chaos/random → master tune drift, dual unison oscillators (saw + brighter triangle-like), reduced unison width, opposing LFO pans, mild LP filter, space reverb with post-filter open.

source.title: Serum Tutorial - Warm 'Analog' Cinematic Pad Synth

prerequisites: Polyphonic synth with ≥2 osc, unison, mod matrix/LFO, LP filter, reverb
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.
Keep unison stereo width moderate (~50%) if you will add manual pan modulation.
Post-reverb filter: fully open cutoff can still dull highs — automate filter mix/bypass when opening fully.

steps.action: Before oscillators, route a slow chaos/random/noise mod source to master tune (or global pitch) for gentle analog-style pitch drift.
Osc A: choose an analog/Juno-like saw; set ~5 unison voices; soften amp attack and release for a pad contour.
Osc B: choose a softer/scuffed triangle-like analog wave; ~5 unison; pitch +1 octave; mix level slightly under Osc A.
steps.expect: Floaty upper harmonics filling the spectrum

steps.action: In global/unison settings, reduce per-oscillator unison stereo width to ~50% so later pan mods have room.
steps.expect: Width not maxed before pan motion

steps.action: Free-running very-slow LFO → Osc A pan and Osc B pan with inverted depth so they sweep opposite sides.
Optional: layer a quiet granular/noise texture under the oscs for enharmonic air (original sample, not a ripped pack).
12 dB low-pass: tame Osc A + noise highs so Osc B harmonics read; also LFO-modulate filter pan/offset for extra stereo motion.
steps.expect: Balanced highs with moving stereo filter image

steps.action: Add spacious reverb; place another filter after reverb and slowly open it (or raise filter mix) over time for a blooming spacey finish.
steps.expect: Pad blooms into space without static dullness

verification: Pitch drift audible but not seasick
Unison width not stuck at 100% before pan mods
Reverb then opening filter increases air over time
